QuestInfo.name: The Wild Hunter's Awakening
QuestInfo.1: Belle said that after the Maple Alliance was formed, the Empress Cygnus decided to use her power to draw out the potential of the Resistance, after hearing from Claudine that they were falling behind in training and organization. She told you to bring some Alexandrite from the mysterious mine and bring it to the Empress at the Conference Pavillion of the Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: With the Alexandrite to help channel her powers, the Empress Cygnus unlocked the hidden powers of the Resistance. Now, they are truly a force to be reckoned with!
